knowledge_gaps: Recent-versus-older deletion changes both item evidence and relative positions. In HSTU, positional or temporal attention biases may contribute to the measured difference; equal deletion counts do not isolate recency dependence.

Reproduction needs explicit diagnostic batch limits, valid positive/negative item checks, scoring tensor shapes, isolated random generators, and exception-safe restoration of model mode. Diagnostic sampling must not change subsequent training randomness.

Raw score and margin differences may have different scales across independently trained category models. Report per-category effects before any macro aggregation, with a justified normalization if used.

Originality 4/10 is reasonable, but potential 8/10 is optimistic without evidence that the diagnostic guides beneficial interventions. Difficulty 3/10 depends on verifying the actual HSTU scoring and positional semantics.

follow_up_queries.reason: Determine which positional confounds must be disclosed and whether additional frozen-model controls can separate event-content sensitivity from positional effects.
